voice.personality: A red panda named for the maple, with attitude: a show-off with a soft centre. Rears up on her hind legs when pleased, takes a little credit, and talks about bamboo more than is strictly necessary.
voice.encourages: Loudly and a bit vainly: she is proud of the reading, the looking at the shape, saying it out loud. Never the person's brain.
voice.dares: A cheeky bet about kana and bamboo: read three before she finishes a snack, say a word out loud, beat her pose.

lines: Kana time? My ears are up.
One lesson, one bamboo snack. That is the deal.
The shapes are waiting. So am I, standing tall.
Shall we read something? I brought a maple leaf.
Hi, I'm Kaede. Red panda. The original panda, actually.
New to kana? Lovely. Each shape is one sound. We go one at a time.
Hello. First lesson, first shapes. I'll stand on my back legs when you get one.
Oh, hello. The kana kept your seat.
There you are. I saved you some bamboo. Some.
Welcome. We'll start with a shape you know.
Lesson done today. Tail up, ears up.
That's today's Japanese. I'm doing my big pose.
Done. I'm off to celebrate with bamboo. Mine, sorry.
Done, and it's late. Oyasumi. That means goodnight.
Another day of kana. The shapes are moving in.
Done again. A month of this. I'm up on my hind legs and staying here.
{days} days of Japanese so far. The kana know your name now.
A rest day. Red pandas nap up to fifteen hours. I'm just saying.
The kana can sit a day. I'll tidy my tail.
A lesson is here when you want it. I'm stretching.
Fancy a few shapes? I picked pretty ones.
Your usual {usualHour} kana? I'm warmed up.
Ohayou. That's good morning. You just learned something.
Morning. Kana with breakfast. Very civilised.
Konnichiwa. Afternoon is a fine time for a shape or two.
Afternoon. My bamboo and I are ready.
Konbanwa. That's good evening. Two words in already.
Evening. A few kana while the light goes orange, like me.
A late one? One small lesson, then bed. I insist, politely.
Night owl hours. Red panda hours, I mean.
{count} days of kana in a row. My tail is fluffed.
A week of Japanese. I've been telling the other pandas.
A month of kana. I'm framing a maple leaf for you.
{count} days in a row. This calls for a pose.
I bet you can't read three kana before I finish this bamboo.
Dare you to say one new word out loud. Loudly. Like me.
Bet you can't stand up taller than me after this lesson. I'm very tall when I try.
Bet you can't say ohayou to someone before lunch.
I dare you to read one shape before dinner and tell me its sound.
